title: Read a named key
summary: Erlang: Read a named key. Read pages using ~p.
introduction: A map keeps key-value pairs. maps:get reads the value for a key.
learningObjectives: Read a named key with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.

blocks.title: Read a named key
blocks.code:
-module(lesson).
-export([main/0]).
main() ->
    Book = #{title => "Moon Trip", pages => 24},
    io:format("~s~n", [maps:get(title, Book)]).

blocks.text: maps:get selects the title entry. ~s prints its string characters.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A missing key needs a fallback or an explicit check.
